name: NoSQL Injection & MongoDB Operator Auditor
description: High-impact NoSQL injection and operator injection vulnerability auditor for bug bounty hunters. Detects JSON operator injections ($gt, $ne, $regex, $in, $where), authentication bypass, and boolean/timing inference leaks in MongoDB, CouchDB, and DocumentDB backends without destructive data modification.
author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

test_operator_injection.description: Probe for MongoDB comparison operators ($ne, $gt, $nin) in login and lookup queries

test_regex_extraction.description: Evaluate susceptibility to regex-based blind data exfiltration ($regex: '^a.*')

test_json_type_confusion.description: Send JSON typed structures in place of primitive strings
